hub.title: Services Hub
hub.intro: Every tool in Ceramony, in one place — what each one does, how far along you are with it, and a direct link to jump in.

aiGenerator.title: AI Page Generator
aiGenerator.description: Answer a few questions about your business and the AI writes your landing page copy, picks a template, and sets up a pipeline that fits how you sell.
aiGenerator.tooltip: Rerunning this never wipes your uploaded photos, or overrides copy you've since hand-edited without asking first.

landingPage.title: Landing Page Editor
landingPage.description: Hand-edit your headline, features, gallery, and template — no need to rerun the AI for a small change.
landingPage.tooltip: Changes go live on your public page as soon as you save.

leads.title: Leads Inbox
leads.description: Every visitor who fills out your landing page form lands here instantly, ready to work.
leads.tooltip: The unread count follows you across the sidebar and this hub until you open a lead.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: A drag-and-drop board of every lead, organized by the stage they're at in your sales process.
pipeline.tooltip: Stages are yours to rename, reorder, or add — the AI only suggests a starting set.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: A simple address book for people and companies you work with, separate from your incoming leads.
contacts.tooltip: Search, edit, and delete inline — no separate detail page to navigate to.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Schedule meetings, calls, and demos, and link them straight to the lead or contact they're about.
calendar.tooltip: Month, week, and day views, plus a status you control — including flagging one for an AI-drafted follow-up.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Visit-to-lead conversion, revenue, response times, and where your traffic actually comes from.
analytics.tooltip: The 1-year and 3-year windows are a Pro-plan feature — Free covers the last 30 days.

cv.title: Resume / CV Studio
cv.description: Build a CV, let the AI polish it, and export a PDF — or share it with a public link.
cv.tooltip: Making it public is opt-in and off by default — no one sees it until you choose to share the link.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: What Ceramony does for you without being asked: an email alert on a new lead, an AI-drafted reply you can send in one click, and follow-ups you can flag for AI help on your calendar.
automation.tooltip: Every AI action here is a suggestion you approve — never something sent on your behalf automatically.

billing.title: Team & Billing
billing.description: Invite teammates with a restricted role, and manage your plan.
billing.tooltip: Only owners and admins see this card — team-wide settings stay out of a member's way.

tutorial.s1a: When you first sign up, describe your business in a sentence or two. The AI setup fills in your company profile, writes starter copy, and picks a landing page layout — you're not starting from a blank page.
tutorial.s1b: Everything it generates is editable afterwards, so it's a starting point, not a lock-in.
tutorial.s2a: Pick from four layouts, choose your grid and column style, and add up to six photos to your gallery. Your brand colors and fonts carry across the whole page automatically.
tutorial.s3t: Every lead lands in one place
tutorial.s3a: Visitors who fill out your landing page form show up instantly in your Leads inbox and your pipeline board. Nothing to connect, nothing to configure — it just works the moment your page goes live.
tutorial.s4t: Keep your own notes and lists
tutorial.s4a: The Workplace section in your sidebar is yours to shape: create documents for notes and plans, or tables with typed columns for anything you want to track — supplier lists, follow-ups, pricing, whatever your business needs.
tutorial.s5a: Analytics shows where your leads come from, how your pipeline is moving, and which parts of your page get the most attention — so you know what to double down on.
